title: Disposable Sample greeting plan
goal: Implement and verify Sample.Greeting.Format(string? name) within the specified sample files.

tasks.description: Implement Sample.Greeting.Format(string? name) and configure the scoped sample solution and projects as needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Changes are limited to the five scoped files.
Null, empty and whitespace-only input return exactly "Hello!".
Nonblank input has surrounding whitespace trimmed and returns exactly "Hello, <trimmed name>!".
Unicode names and internal whitespace are preserved.

tasks.description: Add and run greeting tests in tests/Sample.Tests/GreetingTests.cs using the scoped test project.
acceptanceCriteria: Surrounding whitespace input "  Ada  " returns "Hello, Ada!".
Whitespace-only input, including spaces, tabs and newlines, returns "Hello!".
Unicode input "李雷" returns "Hello, 李雷!".
All greeting tests pass, and the test command and results are recorded as review evidence.
Changes remain within the scoped files.

tasks.description: Review implementation correctness, security and test evidence for the disposable Sample.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the method signature, trimming behavior and exact output strings satisfy the requirements.
Confirm null handling is safe and supplied names are treated as data without execution or unintended side effects.
Confirm test evidence demonstrates passing ordinary, trimmed, null, empty, whitespace and Unicode cases.
Confirm changes are limited to the five scoped files and introduce no Billing functionality or additional business requirements.
Record review findings and identify any unresolved correctness, security or test-evidence issues.

assumptions: This is a disposable Sample project, not Billing.
Scope is limited to Sample.slnx, src/Sample/Sample.csproj, src/Sample/Greeting.cs, tests/Sample.Tests/Sample.Tests.csproj and tests/Sample.Tests/GreetingTests.cs.
